author: Mark Atwood
text: Re-labeling `opinion` -> `human` during /do-beads sweep. The bead body says verbatim: "There is no engineering basis for one over the other unless the maintainer adopts a workspace policy." That is the textbook "human-decision needed" shape (same as siblings .26 / .38 / .41 / .54). The `opinion` label suggests bikeshedding-tolerable, but the api-contract / immutability labels say once 0.x ships either convention, the alternative is a SemVer-breaking change. The `human` label captures "this is a real workspace-canonical-direction decision, not bikeshedding" more accurately. /do-beads spec step 1 skips human-labeled beads; with the new label, this stays parked in the human-decision pool with the other five siblings.
